slots.node01.text: Most of the delay is waiting, so the fix is a change in sequence and ownership more than a change in tools.
slots.node02.label: Sequence
slots.node02.title: Check as entries post
slots.node03.text: Today review happens after the books are drafted. We move rules to the point of entry, so a bad accrual is caught by the person who posted it, with the context still fresh.
slots.node04.label: Ownership
slots.node04.title: Name an owner per task
slots.node05.text: Every close task gets one owner, a due time and an escalation path. When a task slips, the controller sees it on day one rather than finding it on day nine.
slots.title: Sequence and ownership drive the gain
